Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse NpcSkin

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcSkin
public final class NpcSkin extends Object
A resolved player skin: the base64 texture property Mojang issues, with its optional signature.

This is the final form a skin takes — a SkinSource is what gets resolved into one of these, possibly by an HTTP call. Storing the resolved value means a restart does not have to hit Mojang's session servers again.

The signature matters more than it looks. Vanilla clients only render a skin whose texture property carries Mojang's signature; an unsigned skin shows the default Steve or Alex model. An unsigned skin is still worth keeping, because servers running in offline mode with a proxy that forwards profile properties may accept one, so this type represents it rather than rejecting it.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

      public static NpcSkin unsigned(String value)
      Creates an unsigned skin.

      Vanilla clients will not render this. Use it only when a proxy or authentication setup is known to supply the signature separately.

      value - the base64 textures property value
      Gibt zurück:
      the unsigned skin

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a description that deliberately omits the texture payload.

      The value is several hundred characters of base64 and the signature is longer still; printing either turns a log line into noise, so only the length and signing state appear.

      Setzt außer Kraft:
      toString in Klasse Object
      Gibt zurück:
      a short description
